content.text: Log in for full access The SingersFilm releasing in the United States on February 13th, 2026LoglineInspired by the 19th-century short story, THE SINGERS follows a group of down-on-their-luck bar patrons as they find unexpected connection through an impromptu sing-off.SynopsisFrom two-time Academy Award® Nominated filmmaker Sam Davis, The Singers is a genre-bending film adaptation of a 19th-century short story written by Ivan Turgenev, in which a lowly pub full of downtrodden men connect unexpectedly through an impromptu sing-off.
